text: I was hurt in a car accident in Perth. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Perth. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
If you were injured in a motor vehicle accident in Perth, you will generally be dealing with the Insurance Commission of Western Australia (ICWA), which manages Compulsory Third Party (CTP) insurance in WA.

Many reputable compensation and personal injury law firms operate in Perth, handling car accident claims on a **No Win, No Fee** basis.[www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/wa/perth/#:~:text=Our%20Perth%20office%20specialises%20in%20the%20following,compensation%20you're%20entitled%20to.%20Find%20out%20more.) Options include:

### Major National & Local Firms in Perth

* **Slater and Gordon Lawyers:** Located in Perth's legal district (Cathedral Square), they specialize in motor vehicle accident and CTP claims.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/motor-vehicle-accidents/car-accident-lawyers-in-perth#:~:text=Our%20location.%20Our%20office%20is%20conveniently%20located,to%20your%20circumstances.%20View%20our%20Perth%20team.)
* **Shine Lawyers:** Situated on Hay Street in Perth, they provide comprehensive personal injury and road accident claim services.[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/wa/perth#:~:text=Shine%20Lawyers%20Perth.%20Level%206%2F524%20Hay%20Street.%20Perth.%20WA%206000.%20%2808%29%206212%208400.)
* **LHD Lawyers:** Offers dedicated support for ICWA motor injury claims, medical expenses, and income support.[www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/wa/perth/#:~:text=Our%20Perth%20team%20helps%20with%20ICWA%20motor,more%20about%20Car%20Accident%20Claims%20in%20Perth.)
* **CLP Legal:** A trusted Western Australian personal injury firm with extensive experience handling car crash compensation claims.[lawconnect.com](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/motor-vehicle-accident/wa/perth-6000#:~:text=Serving%20clients%20across%20Western%20Australia%2C%20we%20represent,firm%20with%20offices%20in%20Perth%20and%20Fremantle.)
* **Scarff Compensation Lawyers:** An independent WA-based firm focusing heavily on maximizing compensation for motor vehicle and road accident injuries.[lawconnect.com](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/motor-vehicle-accident/wa/perth-6000#:~:text=Committed%20to%20easing%20financial%20stress%2C%20CLP%20Legal,ensuring%20your%20rights%20and%20entitlements%20are%20protected.)
* **Simon Walters Personal Injury Lawyer:** A specialized, highly experienced local practice handling motor vehicle and accident claims in Perth.[simonwalters.com.au](https://simonwalters.com.au/#:~:text=At%20Simon%20Walters%2C%20our%20personal%20injury%20law,injury%2C%20workers'%20compensation%2C%20and%20public%20liability%20claims.)

---

### What to Keep in Mind

1.  **Initial Consultations:** Most of these firms offer a **free, no-obligation initial consultation** to review the details of your crash and determine if you have a viable claim.[www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/wa/perth#:~:text=We%20can%20meet%20with%20you%20at%20home%2C,options%20available.%20*%20Explain%20our%20fee%20arrangements.)
2.  **No Win, No Fee:** Ensure you clarify the terms of any "No Win, No Fee" agreement, as you may still be responsible for out-of-pocket disbursements (like medical reports) even if legal fees aren't charged upfront.
3.  **ICWA Claim Timeframes:** In Western Australia, motor vehicle injury claims through the ICWA have specific statutory time limits, so it is best to seek advice promptly.

Have you already reported the accident to the police and lodged a claim with the Insurance Commission of Western Australia (ICWA)?
